Description.name: Rare Rootitoot
Description.description: Rare Rootitoot loves to radiate a healthy glow, but too many roastings in its tanning bed have caramelized it to a golden orange shade quite unlike that of its Common cousin! Nonetheless, the Fiery-hued Rare is rolling with its new look and embracing the root veggie vibe with a leafy do. As they always say, Rare Rootitoots are good for your eyes!
